news.summary: Alcaraz beat China's Wu Yibing 6-3, 6-4, 6-1, while Sabalenka defeated Kamilla Rakhimova 6-3, 6-4.

news.headline: Have scientists discovered a dark matter particle?
news.summary: Dark matter is an invisible substance that is said to bind the universe; scientists may have found new signs of it.
